title: Chatswood art centre

paragraphs.text: Now listen carefully and answer questions one to five.
Good afternoon, Chatswood Art Centre, Liz speaking. How may I help you?

Hi, my name's Kevin. I'm calling for some information about the art classes your center offers, but I want to check that you're the place I'm thinking of. Are you on the corner of Grey Street and Queens Road?
Yes, that's us.
Great. So could you tell me when your next lot of art classes begins and how long they last?
Our next session starts on the fifth of September and goes on until the twenty-eighth of November.
So that's, let me see, 12 weeks. And how much do the courses cost?
Each course is priced differently, but the range is from two hundred dollars to five hundred dollars for the session.
Does that include everything?
It covers all your tuition fees, but for some courses, materials are extra.
That's fair enough. I thought that might be the case. And if I decide to do a course, how do I pay? Can I pay by credit card?
No, I'm afraid not. It's Internet banking only.
Do you have the bank account number?
Okay. Now, the other thing I need to know is about transport. How easy is it to get to the center?
The number ten bus from the city stops just by the supermarket. Our building is just a five-minute walk from there, right by the hospital.
Great. And do I contact you to enroll?
No. Our enrollment officer's Sally Patterson. That's P-A-double T-E-R-S-O-N. You can contact her on this number.
Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions six to ten. Now listen and answer questions six to ten.
So now I'd like some information about your courses.
Well, there are four adult classes in the next session. There's a drawing class on Friday evenings.
That sounds interesting, and the time suits. I'm really interested in drawing landscapes.

Well, it might not be for you. This class uses humans as its models. As it's an introductory class, you don't draw things like hands and feet. The focus is on faces. There's no extra fees for this class. We provide the paper, but you need to have your own pencils with you.
Hmm. What else is there? I read something about a film class.

Yes. Wednesday morning film class is very popular. In it, you learn how to turn your drawings into a cartoon of about five minutes. At the end of the course, it's quite exciting because we like to show what you've produced, and so we have a competition for everyone that's taken part.
That sounds interesting. Are there extra fees for it?
No, everything's included.
Okay. This class is a real possibility, but I was thinking about painting. Do you offer a painting class?
Yes, on Tuesday afternoons. It focuses on different techniques for painting landscapes.
It sounds advanced.

To enroll in this class, you'd need to have done the introductory class in painting. We provide paint, brushes, and canvases. Oh, and by the way, you should know that the class takes place in the park just behind the studio.
Oh, interesting. Is that all you have?
No. We also have a photography class.
